description.describe_ch: 研究顯示，許多社會人士面臨在職場上使用英語溝通表達的困境。職場英文EZ Talk課程目的在培養學生未來在英語職場上的所需要表達能力。課程設計著重於增進學生的口說能力及英語聽力。課程內容針對職場常用的主題和情境，提供專業職場英文會話練習。課程包含多元的學習活動來引起學生的學習動機。
description.describe_eh: Research shows that speaking problems can be major challenge to many people in the workplace. The Business Conversation course aims at preparing students for working in an English-speaking job environment. The design of the course focuses on improving students’ speaking and listening skills by providing conversation practices of different workplace settings. The course includes a variety of activities to motivate students’ learning interests.

targets.describe_ch: 1. 協助學生分辨並應用所學到的知識於未來職場中。並提升學生未來所需要具備的溝通能力及技巧。
targets.describe_en: 1.Assist students to identify and apply their knowledge in the workplace and develop students’ communicative skills in English.

targets.describe_ch: 2. 協助學生應用所學到的知識，和不同的專業背景的學生互助合作，建立良好的關係。
targets.describe_en: 2.Assist students to apply their knowledge to cooperate with different professions and establish positive relationships.
